'''FC Hoyvík''' is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]] football [[Football team|club]] founded in 2011 after the merger of [[F Giza]] and the original [[FC Hoyvík]]. Initially it was known as '''Giza Hoyvík''' but was renamed to FC Hoyvík after 2018 season and since 2019 was known as '''FC Hoyvík'''. The club is based in [[Hoyvík]], and play their home matches in [[Hoyvíksvøllur]]."}}
